Most Vigos cultivate an air of nobility, taste, and culture, which only their immense wealth and power can provide. The Vigo presented here does not fit that category. Brutish, tough, and absolutely merciless, he controls his criminal empire by breaking heads and using force to take what he wants. Although perfectly capable of negotiating or using persuasion, a Black Sun Vigo prefers the sort of diplomacy that comes out the end of his gun.

The Black Sun Vigo represents a perfect "boss" to be confronted at the end of an adventure, after the heroes have faced hordes of thugs and minions. Thanks to their vast wealth, a Black Sun Vigo can arm their enforcers with the best weapons, armor, and vessels to make life miserable for anyone that rubs them the wrong way. Unlike the

, this Black Sun Vigo prefers getting into a scrap to "make an example" of their enemies, but is smart enough to make a tactical retreat if things go wrong. They rule through fear and intimidation, demanding utter subservience from their minions, and has little compunction about sending them into potentially suicidal situations.
